title: Power Automate: view property values inline on cards in the new cloud flow designer
summary: The roadmap supports the feature description, release scope and maker-selected default. However, the Layout instructions omit closing the configuration pane, and the licensing discussion overlooks published Power Automate entitlements. Statements ruling out changes to data access and flow execution go beyond the evidence.

claims.claim: The cited designer article does not specifically describe displaying runtime output values on cards.
claims.quote: Searched: Read https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/flows-designer in full, including Canvas, Test button and Configuration pane. It documents layout and testing, but not inline runtime output-value display.

claims.claim: The documented maker path is Cloud flow designer > Layout.
claims.quote: The buttons appear at the bottom-left corner of the canvas when the configuration pane is closed.
claims.fix: Replace the path in controls[0].ui and its rendered row with 'Cloud flows designer > Collapse (configuration pane) > Layout'. The cited article labels Collapse as the button that hides the pane; Layout appears at the bottom-left when that pane is closed. 'Cloud flow designer' itself is a descriptive location, not evidence of an invented menu.

claims.claim: No API or automation equivalent for the maker's Layout choice is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Power Automate" "inline" "layout" "API"'; Power Apps administration PowerShell, Power Platform programmability and CLI reference searches for designer layout. Opened flows-designer and powerapps-powershell; no layout operation found.

claims.claim: No tenant or environment UI switch or API specifically controlling this inline property-value view is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Power Automate" "inline" "designer" "admin" setting' and designer-layout searches of Power Platform programmability, CLI and administration PowerShell. Read flows-designer and searched powerapps-powershell; no feature-specific switch found.

claims.claim: The cited article does not explicitly identify Layout as the switch for the roadmap's runtime property-value view.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Power Automate" "inline" "layout" "API"'; read https://learn.microsoft.com/power-automate/flows-designer in full. Layout is described for action properties, without identifying runtime output-value display.
